verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a cloud compute platform like Modal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of region selection or data residency controls. Environments (modal-docs-26/27/28) are logical workspace partitions, not geographic regions, and GPU type selection is unrelated, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
